_comment: Other Services. PUBLIC-NEUTRAL and deliberately thin — this page exists to route, not to sell. Architecture v3 §5 gives the on-page title as 'Other Services' and one line positioning these as standalone help, with a small link back to the plans for anyone who wants the whole growth side. Footer-linked only; it is never in the primary navigation.
title: Other Services — standalone help for one problem
meta_description: Marketing, business consulting, product design and factory labour hiring for Indian furniture businesses. Standalone help for one problem.

sections.headline: Other Services
sections.body: Help with one specific problem. If you want the whole growth side handled instead, start with the plans.

items.title: Furniture Growth & Marketing
items.body: Google and Meta advertising built for furniture, and the follow-up that turns an enquiry into a showroom visit.

items.title: Furniture Business Consulting
items.body: Pricing, showroom, production and profit — the problems advertising on its own cannot fix.

items.title: Furniture Product Design
items.body: From a reference photo to something your factory can actually build, and sell at a sensible price.

items.title: Furniture Labour Hiring
items.body: Help finding sofa carpenters, upholsterers, tailors and polishers when production is short-handed.

sections.headline: Want the whole growth side handled?
sections.body: Most furniture businesses do not need one of these on its own. They need the customers coming in and somebody answering every enquiry.
